title: Church Service and Ministry
definition: Church Service and Ministry is the shared labor of believers using God-given gifts to build up the body and serve others in love.
summary: Church Service and Ministry is the active use of gifts, time, strength, and compassion to build up Christ's body.
christFocus: Jesus Christ served His people and equips them to serve one another in His name.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church service and ministry refers to the many ways believers use their gifts for the good of the body. Scripture teaches that ministry is not reserved for a platform class; every believer is called to serve.

Service in the church includes visible and hidden work, teaching and mercy, administration and encouragement, prayer and practical help. The body needs both public and quiet faithfulness.

Jesus came not to be served but to serve. Ministry in His name should carry His humility, truth, compassion, and endurance.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because churches can become consumer spaces where a few serve and many watch. This doctrine helps every believer see that they have a place of meaningful service under Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask where your gifts, limits, and season can serve the body faithfully. Do hidden work gladly, avoid comparison, and serve people rather than chasing recognition.
